mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO property_amenities (property_id, amenity_type, amenity_name, amenity_latitude, amenity_longitude, distance_meters, walk_time_minutes) VALUES (#{propertyId}, #{amenityType}, #{amenityName}, #{amenityLatitude}, #{amenityLongitude}, #{distanceMeters}, #{walkTimeMinutes})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE property_id = property_id
mapper.select: SELECT property_id, amenity_type, amenity_name, amenity_latitude, amenity_longitude, distance_meters, walk_time_minutes FROM property_amenities WHERE property_id = #{propertyId}
